links.title: Europe H200 GPU utilization

links.title: Huanjing B300 development GPU utilization
links.description: Entire Huanjing (环京) B300 development fleet through domestic central Grafana with the verified Huanjing datasource selected. Fresh telemetry reported eight GPU hosts on 30 October 2026. Grafana login required. The dashboard uses HTTP.

links.title: Shanghai B300 GPU utilization
links.description: Entire Shanghai B300 fleet through domestic central Grafana with the verified Shanghai datasource selected. Fresh telemetry reported 16 GPU hosts on 30 October 2026. Grafana login required. The dashboard uses HTTP.

links.title: Taiguo GB300 GPU utilization
links.description: Taiguo GB300 fleet through overseas central Grafana with the verified Thailand datasource selected. On 30 October 2026, the datasource returned no current GPU samples. Grafana login required. The dashboard uses HTTP.

links.title: Domestic central Grafana · Dynamo runtime operations
links.description: Dynamo Runtime Operations in the domestic central Grafana. The global-prometheus data source covers domestic (China) clusters, with all namespaces and clusters selected, a rolling 30-minute window, and 30-second refresh. Login may be required. The dashboard uses HTTP.

links.title: Overseas central Grafana · Dynamo runtime operations
links.description: Dynamo Runtime Operations in the overseas central Grafana. The global-prometheus data source covers overseas clusters, with all namespaces and clusters selected, a rolling 30-minute window, and 30-second refresh. Login may be required. The dashboard uses HTTP.

links.title: Taiguo GLM-5.2 EAGLE acceptance
links.description: Live speculative-decoding accept rate and accept length for the Ready Taiguo GLM-5.2 deployment in maas-dev-zhouyulin. The Grafana target currently uses HTTP.

links.title: Alex Replay / MaaS test platform
links.description: Domestic Alex test platform for Replay, load tests, and endpoint debugging. Login required. The service currently uses HTTP.
